documented_probe: C-97ca5dea (compute round accuracy excluding invalid and unmatched pairs): covering task; the reference implementation is the same computation but the scenario and interface differ from the existing task (standalone scoring CLI over JSON answer files vs a function inside a numeric toolkit). The verifier fully checks the capability on hidden cases.
notes: Single-stage: reconcile two JSON answer files per round, drop invalid (ERR/non-numeric) and unmatched pairs, exact numeric equality on survivors, half-up rounding of accuracy to 3 decimals, null accuracy for rounds with no valid pairs, string-sorted round ids. Nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth (pair/round reconciliation + half-up ties), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (5 hidden cases: errs on either/both sides, unmatched, empty inputs, string sort order, int-vs-float equality), and quantitative_correctness (exact ints and rounded floats). Totals bucket to easy.
